content:
nina: Noticing small invoice-preview spike around 04:05 UTC for tenant zeta after gateway change that set expand_batches=true for canary.

omar: Alert: https://console.redwood.internal/alerts/invoice-delta?ts=1717000000

nina: Quick check of ingest: see both batch_summary events and expanded item events for same batch_id. Example logs: 
[2026-03-22T04:05:12Z] INGRESS id=a1 tenant=zeta batch_id=bz42 summary=true tokens=300 emit=true
[2026-03-22T04:05:12Z] INGRESS id=a2 tenant=zeta batch_id=bz42 item_idx=0 tokens=150 emit=true
[2026-03-22T04:05:12Z] INGRESS id=a3 tenant=zeta batch_id=bz42 item_idx=1 tokens=150 emit=true

billing-bot: billing_event_rate for tenant=zeta increased 8x coincident with expand_batches toggle :warning: 

platform-sre: Likely double-counting at aggregator. Short-term: disable expand_batches for canary. Medium: make aggregator prefer summary when batch_id present unless route flag says otherwise.

devex: Console enhancement: show batch_id breakdown in invoice-preview so customers can see whether summary vs items were used. Small change.

omar: Toggling feature-flag off for zeta canary now. Will open PR to change aggregator dedupe key to include batch_id and prefer summary.

nina: Kicking off targeted backfill for zeta to reconcile preview numbers.

billing-bot: backfill job 9001 queued for tenant=zeta ETA ~90m

platform-sre: Action items: 1) PR to aggregator (48h) 2) console card for batch semantics (devex) 3) canary test that simulates batch summary+expanded emission.

nina: Thanks, will follow up with postmortem once backfill finishes.
